english.title: Exporter / shipper load / ship / export explosives without due entry made in the proper form
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[exporter]_
(B)_[shipper]_

of explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EXPLOSIVES..),

(C)_[loaded into a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), for exportation]_
(D)_[loaded into an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), for exportation]_
(E)_[exported by land]_
(F)_[shipped for carriage coastwise as cargo]_

before due entry had been made of the goods in such form and manner and containing such particulars as directed by the Commissioners
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
exporter / shipper of explosives
loaded into a ship / aircraft for exportation or
exported by land or
shipped for carriage coastwise as cargo
before due entry has been made of the goods
in such form and manner
containing such particulars as directed by the Commissioners

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 75(2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that the goods are liable to forfeiture.
